name: What are some popular design trends for bathroom refreshes in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular design trends for bathroom refreshes in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current bathroom refresh trends in the Bay Area often lean towards clean, minimalist designs with a focus on natural materials and efficient use of space. Popular choices include floating vanities, large format tiles, integrated smart technology like dimmable lighting, and water-efficient fixtures. Earthy tones, matte black finishes, and subtle textures are also frequently requested to create a serene and modern spa-like atmosphere.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular Bay Area trends include minimalist designs, natural materials, floating vanities, large format tiles, smart tech, and water-efficient fixtures.
